newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Sovereign places Metro Life shares at $1.25.
newsitem.headline: Sovereign places Metro Life shares at $1.25.

text.p: New Zealand's Sovereign Assurance Holdings said on Thursday it had placed 7.08 million shares in Metropolitan Lifecare Group Limited predominantly with institutional investors at NZ$1.25 each.

"The sale of these shares was undertaken to give Sovereign an appropriate spread of assets in its portfolio after the acquisition of Metropolitain Life. The remaining shares owned by Sovereign are considered a core investment by the company and it is not intended that they will be sold," the company said in a statement.
The placement was arranged by Clavell Capital Ltd, the company added.
Metropolitan is the only listed company in its field, providing private nursing homes, hospitals and retirement housing.
Its share price rose three cents on the day to NZ$1.30.
